annotations.title: Check email security of a domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)

description: Checks the public DNS records that protect a domain against e-mail spoofing: SPF, DKIM (common selectors), DMARC, DNSSEC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI and CAA. Returns an overall assessment, one finding per check and recommendations. Use it for a company domain, not for single mailboxes. Nothing is stored. Rate limited per connection.

domain.description: Public domain name, e.g. "example.de" (an e-mail address or URL is reduced to its domain)

sprache.description: Output language. Default: German if the input is German, otherwise English.

name: check_email_security

gespeichert.description: Nothing about this check is stored by frag.hugo
